items.title: Move the page CSS and JS into plugins/harness/pages asset files (todo-h4za, issue 289)
items.action: Create plugins/harness/pages/styles/shared.css with the theme part of _STYLE (the :root color variables and their dark block, body, code, a, .note/.meta) and pages/styles/plan.css with the rest (dl.head, table, .item, .status, .receipt, .change, :target). Create pages/components/plan.js with the _LOADER text unchanged. In plan_render_html.py add PAGES = plugin_root() / 'pages' (import plugin_root from harness_lib.project) and _asset(folder, name) reading a file as utf-8 inside the function, never at import; _style() returns shared.css then plan.css, and _script() inlines plan.js. Spell 'shared.css', 'plan.css' and 'plan.js' in code string literals so tools/select_tests.py maps an asset edit to the module. Delete the _STYLE and _LOADER literals and update the module docstring. No pages/views folder (D2A). Add '.css' and '.html' to TEXT_SUFFIXES in tests/contract/test_no_repo_literals.py so the ban list scans the new assets. The rendered page keeps its rules and loader; only the order of CSS rules may change by the split.

commands.expect: all pass: the existing page tests hold after the move

items.title: Bump harness to 0.74.0, extend the v1.0.0 notes and the write-plan README
items.action: Set plugins/harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json version 0.74.0. In docs/RELEASES/v1.0.0.md change the harness row to 0.65.1 | 0.74.0 and add one line: Feat(write-plan): the HTML PIP opens with a Status list of task headings and live badges, lays out each decision as a block with Chosen and Unchosen (or Open) lists under pill markers drawn like the task status badge, themes headings and code, and reads its CSS and JS from plugins/harness/pages (issues 278, 280, 289). In plugins/harness/skills/write-plan/README.md add to the PIP bullet that the page opens with the Status list, and that an existing page keeps its old layout until it is written again: by plan_api.write, by freeze --refreeze, or by deleting it and running PLAN render <id> (render writes a frozen plan's page only when it is missing). Then run the lint and validate commands.
